messages:
claire_ae: Hey team — NordeaPay (EU bank) opened a trial request. They want: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO 27001 cert, a signed pen-test attestation, an architecture diagram showing VPC/KMS boundaries, and confirmation on EU-only data residency + HSM support. Legal needs these artifacts by 2024-03-31. Can we assemble? cc @dina_salesops @sam_security @matt_solutions

dina_salesops: I can pull together an assurance pack. We have redacted SOC2 and ISO PDFs in the shared drive and a pen-test attestation template. Will need signoff from security for the letter. Link: https://drive.redwood.example/assurance-pack (will upload final files there)

sam_security: We can provide a redacted SOC2 report and the ISO 27001 cert. For pen-test: we issue a penetration testing attestation (signed). Note: we do not share full raw pentest reports without an NDA. Need to confirm whether NordeaPay accepts a redacted attestation or insists on full report. Also clarify: do they require customer-held HSM (FIPS/HSM) or cloud KMS with HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS / Google Cloud KMS)?

julian_customer: They require EU-only storage and customer-controlled HSM for key custody if PI is processed. On-prem is strongly preferred by their security team. Can Redwood spin up a private/on-prem deployment in ~3 weeks? Also need a cost delta vs dedicated hosted in eu-west-1.

matt_solutions: Short answer: private on-prem full install typically takes 6–8 weeks for a full validated deployment and testing. A managed private (VPC + customer infra) can be 3–4 weeks if infra and networking approvals are immediate. Dedicated in EU region is fastest (1–2 weeks). Cost ranking: private (highest) > dedicated > hosted. If you share expected QPS and token volumes I can run a rough estimate.

dina_salesops: I'll start assembling: SOC2 (redacted), ISO cert, architecture diagram, SSO/SAML docs, pen-test attestation draft, KMS integration notes, and a short cover letter for legal. Need NordeaPay legal contact and confirmation they accept redacted copies.

sam_security: Also need a PO / signed SOW before we schedule on-prem work and before security signs off on any attestation that references a private deployment. If they want customer-managed HSM we support both cloud HSM and on-prem HSM, but network/topology & key-access policies differ. We'll need their HSM vendor details and whether key escrow is allowed.

claire_ae: Action items: (1) Dina — prepare and upload full assurance pack by 2024-03-24. (2) Sam — draft pen-test attestation today and call out NDA requirement if they want full report. (3) Matt — prepare a short cost/time estimate for hosted vs dedicated vs private (VPC and on-prem) by EOD. @julian_customer can you share legal contact + expected monthly token usage?

julian_customer: Legal contact: legal.europe@nordeapay.com. Estimated trial volume ~10M tokens/month, projected growth to 50M/mo. They want final artifacts by 2024-03-31 to align with their procurement window.

dina_salesops: Got it — uploading to the shared drive and will ping when done :thumbsup:

sam_security: Drafting pen-test attestation now. Typical attestation language we use: "Redwood Inference confirms a third-party penetration test was conducted on MM/YYYY and no critical findings affecting customer data confidentiality existed at time of testing." If NordeaPay requests the full test report, we will need an NDA and permission from the third-party tester.

matt_solutions: Quick staging note for the deployment team:
```
# example role creation for staging
aws iam create-role --role-name redwood-staging --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
```
Also: EU private region requires some network prep; ops will need 48 business hours notice once SOW is signed.

claire_ae: Perfect. I'll draft an email to NordeaPay summarizing timeline & next steps and include the shared folder link. If anything blocks signoff, flag here and we'll escalate.
